claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 18490 1100mAh 8C as a 1100mAh preset with a 8C runtime rating.

HKJ's historical Efest IMR 18490 1100mAh review records a red V1 sample with no protection circuit and observed dimensions of approximately 18.19 mm x 48.89 mm; the aggregate battery database separately records a V2 button-top variant.

The Efest IMR 18490 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Efest IMR 18490 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-03-17 or earlier.
